as_told: In a sting called Operation Lucky Bag, New York police left bags and wallets with money or valuables in subway stations and other public places. Officers watched, and arrested people who picked them up and walked off instead of handing them in. Many of those arrested had no criminal record.
lesson: Bait stings catch ordinary people who give in to a chance temptation rather than real criminals.
